scope: Native read-only plan historical anchor/baseline/declaration parity and bound staged source closure
execution: Source inspection only; no runtime/build while root session 19323 live

findings.problem: Parent/base epoch rows drive obligations while stage-0 epoch and baseline blobs are only witnessed, not validated against source histories. Truncation, mutation, deletion, or a new staged epoch can escape obligation derivation.
findings.counterexample: Keep original parent/base epochs; replace one staged+working canonical epoch with a shorter valid prefix, or remove its stage-0 entry and working file. Existing staged/working equality checks pass, but recovery still uses parent/base rows.
findings.fix: Parse canonical staged epochs and baseline; require immutable original physical prefixes and baseline retention; derive actual output obligations from the bound staged epoch rows.

findings.problem: Historical-gap authorization decision accepts whitespace through minLength:1 schema, while unchanged anchors.ts additionally rejects decision.trim().length===0.
findings.counterexample: A schema-valid, directly digest-anchored historical-gap payload whose Architect authorization decision is three spaces is accepted natively but rejected as MISSING_AUTHORIZATION by anchors.ts.
findings.fix: After declaration schema validation, enforce nonempty trimmed authorization.decision as unchanged anchors.ts does.

confirmed_alignment: Notes-only anchors resolve only through actual same-source baseline digests; duplicates and missing/mismatched physical lines refuse.
Selected-parent declarations enforce structured direct declaration anchor, matching cutoff, original observed_at, physical digest, no direct target anchor and unique target.
Real readonly remote advertisement is checked twice and bound to config/effective origin, with selected parent required equal to or ancestor of actual observed tip.
limitations: Counterexamples have not been executed; findings follow direct control/data-flow inspection.
